title: Introduce consistent backoff envelopes and headers for streaming + tool calls
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: clients have been handling rate limits and transient errors inconsistently across the OpenAI-compat endpoints (chat/completions/streaming) and tool/function-call routes. Two practical problems we observed: (1) backend 429/503 responses returned ambiguous Retry-After or custom header shapes that SDKs interpreted differently, causing hot loops or wasted retries; (2) streaming frames had informal transient error markers that made deterministic restart/dedup of tool calls difficult for server-side and edge SDKs. This PR introduces a minimal, backwards-compatible error envelope and a small set of well-documented headers to provide deterministic backoff guidance and explicit idempotency semantics for tool/function invocations. Summary of changes: - new response header X-Redwood-Backoff-Hint with comma-separated hint tokens (e.g. "backoff=exponential,initial=200,cap=20000") - X-Redwood-Retry-After-Ms: canonical millisecond retry hint for clients that prefer a single numeric value - unified JSON error envelope field retry_hint_ms and backoff_strategy in the error body for both unary and streaming terminal error events - clarified Idempotency-Key handling for tool/function calls: server-side dedupe scope is "tool-execution:<model>:<tool-name>", TTL 7 days, and duplicate requests return 409 with original result location when available - streaming protocol: introduce stream_resume_id for resumable client reconnects and frame-level "terminal_error" frame with structured envelope for deterministic replays - documented migration notes and SDK helpers for Python/TS to decode headers or fallback to Retry-After semantics Compatibility goals: - preserve existing 429/503 HTTP codes and OpenAI-style error objects where present; the new fields are additive and optional - SDKs should prefer X-Redwood-Retry-After-Ms when present; fall back to Retry-After (seconds) header otherwise - no behavior change for customers who do not opt-in to Idempotency-Key headers; default semantics remain at-most-once for non-tool endpoints Checklist: - [x] Add header parsing and response generation in openai-compat shims - [x] Emit stream_resume_id on session start for streaming endpoints - [x] Implement server-side dedupe lookup for Idempotency-Key on tool calls - [x] Add docs and SDK helpers (python + typescript) - [x] Add unit tests for header parsing, envelope shape, and streaming terminal frames - [x] Run integration test matrix against dedicated + hosted CI Notes/links: Related Linear: ENG-2413. See docs at /docs/openai-compat/backoff.md. This description includes the representative header shapes and sample error envelope below. Example error envelope (HTTP 429 response body): {"error": {"type": "rate_limit", "message": "rate limit exceeded", "retry_hint_ms": 1200, "backoff_strategy": "exponential", "metadata": {"quota_group": "user"}}} Example headers: X-Redwood-Backoff-Hint: backoff=exponential,initial=200,cap=20000 X-Redwood-Retry-After-Ms: 1200 Migration notes (short): - Clients should read X-Redwood-Retry-After-Ms if present; else parse Retry-After seconds; else use the backoff hint as heuristics - SDKs will ship helpers: redwood.api.backoff.from_response() (py) and decodeBackoff(response) (ts) - Idempotency-Key: we recommend generating v4 UUIDs; server will return 409+Location if duplicate. This PR is intentionally additive; follow-up work will propagate these headers into Dedicated telemetry and create an opt-in rollout flag for strict dedupe enforcement.

discussion: Arjun: Requested we namespace headers to X-Redwood- to avoid surprising proxies; asked for explicit numeric ms header to avoid fractional seconds parsing. Maya: Updated headers to X-Redwood-Retry-After-Ms and added a strict parse path; left Retry-After fallback. Sasha: Asked for deterministic behavior when Idempotency-Key store is unavailable (network partition). Maya: Added fallback semantics: when dedupe store is unavailable and request is marked idempotent, server returns 202 Accepted with 'result_pending' and Location; added docs entry. Lauren: Requested explicit test for client reconnect resume and duplicate tool-call race; tests added. Conversation included small follow-ups and a final approval after CI turned green.

release_notes: Additive: servers emit X-Redwood-Retry-After-Ms and X-Redwood-Backoff-Hint to provide deterministic client backoff guidance; Idempotency-Key semantics for tool calls clarified (dedupe scope, TTL=7d), streaming endpoints now support resumable sessions via stream_resume_id and explicit terminal_error frames.
